newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND BEAT BUCHAREST IN EIGHT-GOAL FEAST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND BEAT BUCHAREST IN EIGHT-GOAL FEAST.

text.p: German champions Borussia Dortmund notched up a 5-3 win over Steaua Bucharest of Romania on Wednesday in their final group B match in the European Champions' League.
Although Dortmund had already qualified for the European Cup quarter-finals, they pressed Bucharest from the start.
Stephane Chapuisat gave them an early lead and added a second goal after the Romanians equalised from the penalty spot through Sabin Ilie.

Dortmund midfielder Rene Tretschok struck just before the break to make it 3-1 but Marius Baciu put Steaua back in touch in the 52nd minute. Karlheinz Riedle and Michael Zorc took Dortmund's tally to five in the 62nd and 64th minutes respectively.
Steaua striker Aurel Calin scored a spectacular long-range effort in the 79th minute.
Dortmund will play French side Auxerre in the quarter-finals in March.
